artifacts.title: A notebook of weeknight recipes
artifacts.content: Make a small illustrated booklet of weeknight recipes I have tested at home. Each recipe should include my own margin notes about substitutions and what I would change next time.

artifacts.title: Keeping the notebook personal
artifacts.content: The first edition will collect my recipes and kitchen sketches. I want the notes to feel like a cook's working notebook rather than a formal reference book.

artifacts.title: A recipe swap trial
artifacts.content: At a small dinner, four friends tried the lentil recipe and wrote substitutions in the margins. Their notes were useful, but this was a one-evening experiment, not a change to the booklet plan.

artifacts.title: Testing shared recipe pages
artifacts.content: Made a prototype page with my original recipe and handwritten comments from two friends. We are testing whether the notes are readable; the collection is still my own recipe notebook.

artifacts.title: Proposal for a shared kitchen archive
artifacts.content: Proposed inviting neighbors to contribute recipes and the stories behind their variations. This is a proposal for a possible second edition; contributors have not yet been selected.
